displayTitle: Quick check: what node am I on, and what can you help me with?
goal: Quick check: what node am I on, and what can you help me with?
outcome: You're on Hydra node 123 — 192.168.1.123, a Windows machine running the Hydra client (v0_34). I'm its local agent, so I can look at anything on this box and anything the network exposes to it. What I can help with: This machine — hardware specs (GPU, RAM, disks), running processes, installed models, resource usage. The Hydra network — other nodes, services, active transfers, mining status, scheduler state, whatever the local client can see. And anything else you throw at me: files, scripts, research, web lookups — I have terminal, file, browser, and search tools. Want me to pull a quick hardware/status snapshot, or check something specific on the network?
